Done. The bug was `retry: 2` with backoff on the query: a load that failed once but would have succeeded on a later attempt was silently retried away by TanStack Query before the error state, or your test, ever got a look at it — which is why "a refused load shows the error" and "retry asks exactly once more" were both failing (the explicit Retry button's one click could land on top of the library's own hidden retries). I removed the automatic retry (`retry: false` in `modules/customers/customers.queries.ts`), so the only way a query is asked again is the person pressing Retry — exactly once per press.

The three-way mutual exclusion was already structurally sound (early-return `isPending` → `isError` → table, and TanStack Query's status is exactly one of pending/error/success at a time), so that test was really failing as a side effect of the same bug rather than a separate issue.

Added `modules/customers/customers.queries.test.ts` covering all three behaviors with a fake transport. Full suite: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm test` (25/25) all pass, and I re-verified the real page against the running server at `127.0.0.1:63780` still renders the 25 customer rows correctly.
